changelog:
- Initial release of the skill.
- Enables agents to send email, SMS, and voice calls via the Hail API.
- Self-service signup with free credit, no card or human required.
- Requires lawful recipient consent for all messages.
- Rate limits and anti-spam policies enforced.
- Full documentation and pricing links provided.
summary: Send and receive email, SMS, and phone calls from your agent. Sign up yourself: free credit, no card, no human required.
